title: another pylint stopIteration Runtime Error

labels.name: Crash 💥
labels.description: A bug that makes pylint crash

body:
I'm seeing another "RuntimeError: generator raised StopIteration", similar to the already-fixed #2241.

### Steps to reproduce
1. Make a file with the following contents:
```
class Foo:
    def __init__(self):
        self.count = 5 

    def bar(self):
        records = []
        for _ in []:
            records += []
        records = records[:self.count]
        records.sort()
```
2. Run pylint on the file
